SELECT mmsi, date_bucket, received_at, cog, integrity_flag, latitude, longitude,
  msg_type, nav_status, raim_flag, rot, sog, station_mmsi, sub_message,
  timestamp_sec, true_heading
  FROM dlim.ais_class_a_dynamic
  LIMIT 500;

SELECT mmsi, date_bucket, toa, rssi, sentence_id, slot_num, snr, station_mmsi,
  talker_id
  FROM dlim.signal_information
  LIMIT 500;
